evidence.title: Was it a mistake for 99 Colombian guerrillas to lay down their arms?

occurrences.checkable_against: Colombian security-service intelligence assessments and CNEB membership records
occurrences.quote_span: The 99 made up a small part of a group of about 1,000 combatants called Commandos of the Frontier – most of whom remain armed – and are part of the National Coordinator of the Bolivarian Army (CNEB), a former dissident faction of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (Farc) with about 2,500 members which controls the border with Ecuador.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: ZUT operational records and on-site inspection
occurrences.quote_span: For now, at least, the ZUT remains in operation and has a small library run by Bríñez, who has a phoenix tattoo on her left shoulder as a symbol of her rebirth away from the armed conflict.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Colombian government payment records for ZUT participants
occurrences.quote_span: They were also supposed to receive financial support of about £425 a month, which had not yet been paid.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Petro decree establishing the ZUT and Colombian arrest-warrant records
occurrences.quote_span: In theory, any arrest warrants against the group are suspended, and they remain under state protection until 25 December, when Petro’s decree establishing the ZUT expires.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: ZUT disarmament ceremony records and Colombian conflict casualty datasets
occurrences.quote_span: They also stripped off their heavy tactical vests, field packs and camouflage uniforms, which were each piled into a bonfire to mark the beginning of a new life away from an armed conflict that has claimed nearly half a million lives in the last six decades.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: ZUT roster and Colombian government transition records
occurrences.quote_span: “We’re in limbo,” said Natalia Bríñez, 29, one of 13 women among the group staying in the temporary location zone, or ZUT by its Spanish initials, a government-controlled zone where, under surveillance and unable to leave, they were supposed to make the transition to civilian life over the following months.
occurrences.speaker: Natalia Bríñez
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Colombian disarmament records and presidential runoff result and campaign platform
occurrences.quote_span: But the group of just 99 people was the only one to disarm, and did so just three days before the presidential runoff, which was won by the far-right millionaire lawyer Abelardo de la Espriella, who had campaigned on a promise to end “total peace ” and return to a full-on strategy of jailing or killing criminals.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: The Guardian interview with Natalia Bríñez and ZUT transition program records
occurrences.quote_span: “The hardest thing for me has been being away from my children,” said Bríñez, who has a seven-year-old daughter and a 10-year-old son and speaks to them on video calls, but will only be able to see them in person once her “transition” is complete, a process that includes vocational training and psychosocial support.
occurrences.speaker: Natalia Bríñez
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Correspondence records and response from Abelardo de la Espriella's office
occurrences.quote_span: At the time of publication it had received no response.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Presidential authority and decree establishing the ZUT
occurrences.quote_span: But De la Espriella could revoke the decree at any time.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: ZUT facilities and meal-service records
occurrences.quote_span: The former guerrillas are housed in beige brick buildings decorated with drawings they painted themselves, including doves of peace, with a communal dining hall where three meals a day are served.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: The Guardian interview with Adrián and audio or transcript of the interview
occurrences.quote_span: “Honestly, I’d take up arms again, because we’re keeping our side of the bargain and the government should do the same, shouldn’t it?” he said.
occurrences.speaker: Adrián
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: The Guardian interview with Armando Novoa and transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Armando Novoa, the former government official who led peace negotiations with the group, said “the worst-case scenario would be for the new government to close the ZUT, launch a military operation and try to capture or kill them. That would be a crime against humanity, because these people are unarmed.”
occurrences.speaker: Armando Novoa
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: ZUT security rules and Colombian military deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: No weapons are allowed inside and soldiers guard the ZUT from a perimeter less than a mile away.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Seismological records and Colombian military airstrike records
occurrences.quote_span: Now, several weeks after the new president took office – and amid efforts to deal with the aftermath of the 7.4-magnitude earthquake , as his government has already begun the promised airstrikes against criminal groups – the 99 do not know what will happen to them.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Colombian government transport and disarmament records
occurrences.quote_span: 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Letter from the 99 fighters to Abelardo de la Espriella
occurrences.quote_span: The group wrote a letter to De la Espriella reaffirming its “irreversible decision to commit to peace” and inviting him to visit the ZUT.
occurrences.speaker: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements by Abelardo de la Espriella and government announcements about the ZUT
occurrences.quote_span: De la Espriella has repeatedly said his government will no longer negotiate peace agreements and has yet to announce what he intends to do regarding the people at the ZUT.
occurrences.speaker: Abelardo de la Espriella
occurrences.subject: 99 Colombian guerrilla fighters
